Method of Attack: SDK supply chain attack infecting many Android apps
Trojan stealing files and replacing clipboard contents
Malicious SDK disguised as advertising library serving mini-games with daily rewards
Attack Vector: Malicious SDK embedded in Android apps via supply chain attack
Indicators of Compromise: Set of 193 infected apps including HexaPop Link 2248, Macaron Match, Macaron Boom, Jelly Connect, Tiler Master, Crazy Magic Ball, Happy 2048, Mega Win Slots
IoCs provided in Dr. Web’s report used by CloudSEK to find additional infections
